Description

info.name: P31 - Get products for a list of product references

params.name: product_references
params.description:
List of the product's identifiers with type, _(structure: "`product_references=<productIdType>|<productId>,<productIdType>|<productId>, ...`")_
where accepted `<productIdType>` are operator’s product references, like `EAN` or `UPC` for example.

Note that `SHOP_SKU` or `SKU` are invalid `<productIdType>` for this API.

params.name: products
params.description:
List of the product's identifiers with type, _(structure: "`products=<productId>|<productIdType>,<productId>|<productIdType>, ...`")_
where accepted `<productIdType>` are operator’s product references, like `EAN` or `UPC` for example.

Note that `SHOP_SKU` or `SKU` are invalid `<productIdType>` for this API.

items.docs:
Description
Note: this resource returns 100 products maximum
Results are sorted by product sku asc, then by product identifier type asc and then by product identifier asc
Call Frequency
Recommended usage: At each product page display
Maximum usage: At each product page display
